get_meeting.description: Get one meeting's details: its title, when it happened, how long it ran, who organised it, and who was invited.
get_meeting.name: get_meeting

parameters.description: The meeting's tl;dv id. You can get this from the List tl;dv meetings action, or from the end of a tldv.io meeting URL.
parameters.name: meeting_id

conference_id.description: The underlying conference id from Zoom, Meet, or Teams, useful for matching the meeting to a calendar event.

duration.description: How long the recording runs, in seconds.

happened_at.description: When the meeting took place, ISO 8601.

id.description: tl;dv meeting id, taken by the transcript and notes actions.

template.description: Name of the tl;dv note-taking template applied to the meeting, if any.

url.description: Link to the recording on tldv.io.

get_notes.description: Get a meeting's AI notes: the topics tl;dv identified with a summary each, the individual note lines with timestamps, and the whole thing already rendered as markdown.
get_notes.display_str_template: Get the notes for tl;dv meeting '{0}'.

mock_response.markdown:
## Billing bug
- Ship the billing fix before Friday.

notes.text: Ship the billing fix before Friday.

topics.summary: The team agreed to ship the fix this week.
topics.title: Billing bug

get_notes.name: get_notes

parameters.description: The meeting's tl;dv id. You can get this from the List tl;dv meetings action, or from the end of a tldv.io meeting URL.
parameters.name: meeting_id

markdown.description: The same notes already formatted as markdown, which is usually what you forward to Slack, Notion, or an email.

segment_id.description: The transcript segment the note came from.

timestamp.description: Seconds into the recording that the note refers to.

topic_id.description: Which topic this note belongs to, matching an id in topics.

topics.description: The topics tl;dv split the meeting into, each with its own summary.

order.description: Where the topic falls in the meeting.

get_transcript.description: Get a meeting's full transcript as a list of segments, each with the speaker, what they said, and where it falls in the recording.
get_transcript.display_str_template: Get the transcript for tl;dv meeting '{0}'.

segments.speaker: Ada Lovelace
segments.text: Let's start with last week's numbers.

get_transcript.name: get_transcript

parameters.description: The meeting's tl;dv id. You can get this from the List tl;dv meetings action, or from the end of a tldv.io meeting URL.
parameters.name: meeting_id

meeting_id.description: The meeting the transcript belongs to.

segments.description: The transcript in order, one entry per turn.

end_time.description: Seconds from the start of the recording where this turn ends.

start_time.description: Seconds from the start of the recording where this turn begins.

import_meeting.description: Import a recording from a public URL so tl;dv transcribes it and writes notes. Use this to get recordings from somewhere else into tl;dv. Transcription happens in the background, so this returns a job id rather than a finished meeting.
import_meeting.name: import_meeting

parameters.description: What to call the meeting in tl;dv.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Publicly reachable link to the media file. tl;dv supports .mp3, .mp4, .wav, .m4a, .mkv, .mov, .avi, .wma, and .flac.
parameters.name: url

parameters.description: When the meeting took place, ISO 8601. Defaults to now, so set this when importing something older.
parameters.name: happened_at

parameters.description: Comma-separated email addresses of who was on the call.
parameters.name: participants

parameters.description: Validate the request without actually importing anything. Useful for checking a URL is reachable.
parameters.name: dry_run

job_id.description: The background job tl;dv queued for the import. The meeting appears in List tl;dv meetings once it finishes processing.

list_meetings.description: List recorded meetings, optionally searched by text and filtered by date range or whether the meeting was internal or external. Returns the meeting ids the transcript and notes actions take.
list_meetings.name: list_meetings

parameters.description: Only meetings on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD or a full ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: from_date

parameters.description: Only meetings on or before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD or a full ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: to_date

parameters.description: Narrow to internal meetings, where everyone is from your organisation, or external ones, which include at least one outside guest. Leave blank for both.
parameters.name: meeting_type

parameters.description: Only return meetings the API key's own user attended, rather than everything they can see.
parameters.name: only_participated

parameters.description: Which page of results to return, starting at 1.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many meetings to return per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

count.description: Number of meetings on this page.

conference_id.description: The underlying conference id from Zoom, Meet, or Teams, useful for matching the meeting to a calendar event.

duration.description: How long the recording runs, in seconds.

happened_at.description: When the meeting took place, ISO 8601.

id.description: tl;dv meeting id, taken by the transcript and notes actions.

template.description: Name of the tl;dv note-taking template applied to the meeting, if any.

url.description: Link to the recording on tldv.io.

page.description: Which page this is, starting at 1.

page_size.description: How many meetings each page holds.

pages.description: How many pages match the filters in total.

total.description: How many meetings match the filters in total.

description: Work with your tl;dv meeting recordings: search past meetings, read a meeting's full transcript with speakers and timestamps, pull the AI notes as topics or ready-to-post markdown, and import recordings from elsewhere for tl;dv to transcribe.
